reviews.text: I like this grooming place. I've been a customer for a year now, I believe. The no show fee is appropriate, however, even when there's an emergency reason why you couldn't make your appointment (car accident, medical emergency with discharge/medical note as proof), that doesn't matter. It's pretty disappointing. You would think it would be waived. So, please keep that in mind. Anyway, other than that, I like my dog's groomer. He has a love-hate relationship with her, but he definitely loves her!

I called today to book a nail trim for my fearful and at times reactive dog. Emily was truly so accommodating and non judgmental. She took 30 minutes at the end of the day to let my dog sniff around and get to know her before her nail trim tomorrow with a groomer! Emily went above and beyond, and it’s truly appreciated. Regardless of how my dog does at the appointment, this type of service is a 5/5 and a green flag!

Update: My dog did GREAT with Nicole. Both Nicole and Emily are absolute professionals. The kind of people that love animals, so clearly. Thank you both ♥️

Literally the best groomers around! My poor sweet 10 month old puppy had a pretty rough start to life. She was a street dog that got hit by a car and had both hind legs broken. So naturally she is very scared and skittish and weary of new people and places. This groomer took the extra time needed and was so patient and kind to my sweet girl. They took the time to get warmed up to her when we walked it. They even turned off all the blow dryers when they walked her into the back so she wouldn’t get spooked! These people are genuinely good human beings who so clearly love animals. Their kindness and compassion literally made me tear up. Most places just want to move you in and out as quickly as possible to make as much money as they can, assembly line fashion. Here at this place they really care about your pup and want to make sure they feel safe and have a good grooming experience. I highly recommend this groomer and wish I could give them TEN stars because they deserve every last one. They are AMAZING!!! Book your appointment now and don’t wait!

I've been taking ribbon (dog) here for 3 yrs now , she is a pain but they love her and they've been good too her . Awesome service and I will continue to come here. I think they do cat's to but you'll have to ask them

I followed our groomer, CJ, here from her old employer and am so happy I did! CJ is the best and works so well with my dog always doing an excellent job. The staff here is super friendly and kind, always very welcoming and you can tell they really care about the dogs. They often have little treat bags them and even had a little bandana and bow for my dogs’s birthday. It is a little further from where we live, but VERY worth it to make the drive here!

My three guys, two rough collies and one corgi, entered happily to this place.  We moved out of the state in 2024.  We are still searching for a spa for that compares

TLDR: I miss you ❤️

Everyone here was lovely and understanding of my dogs situation and need for immediate grooming assistance. My dog is definitely not easy to work with but they managed so well and highly exceeded my expectations. She looks fresh and brand new now! Shoutout to the awesome team here!

I’m a long time customer of A4DP. They are a very consistent small business. The food for my dog is almost always in stock.  On the rare occasion that it is not, I’ll get a call from them regarding re-stock.  Their hours are also very convenient.  Friendly staff for asking questions about your pets health as well . Highly recommend.
Super great shop and they have a good selection of raw diet foods. Great treats also. Owners are super friendly and knowledgeable. Love that it’s in the neighborhood.
Great and treat me like family. Thank you so much.

Brought my great pyranees mix for his first groom and staff did an exceptional job on him. Thought the price was a bit high but I think that's what you'll pay anywhere in the city. Nonetheless very happy with how spiffy my dog looks!
Everyone here is so friendly and kind. They do an awesome job and seem to really care about the pets. Stevie and I are big fans.

Five stars all the way! Excellent groomers, great shop with great products, plus everyone is so friendly! The quality of the grooming is outstanding, I have always been so impressed and we are customers for life!
Been taking my giant Golden Doodle to them for years now and have never been disappointed by hair cut or service!

Emily and Sabrina and the rest of their team having been helping Clip my slightly psychotic cats nails for a little over a year now. Gracie can be a handful. But they lock the door to make sure she doesn’t get out, talk kindly to her and use the upmost care while we work together to get her nails trimmed in a fearless and quick amount of time. Cannot recommend their services enough! We were worried about finding someone we loved as much as our person in Colorado Springs, but we are thankful we found them!

We love All 4 Dirty Paws! My dog is a nervous little guy and not the easiest to groom, but they did an amazing job. He got the best haircut he’s ever had, super detailed and well done. Sophia was wonderful with him, and he absolutely loved her. We’ll definitely be coming back!
CJ is amazing. She has been grooming my dog for the whole five years that she’s been alive.
I love this place

Capone & Roofio look amazing...

Thank you CJ!!

I took my cat here to get a bath and they have amazing service the lady at the front desk was very kind to me and my cat. When they returned my cat he smelled good and his nails were trimmed perfectly. Everyone was kind and understanding it’s a little pricey but it’s worth it Thank you all 4 dirty paws I will be returning again.
They are booked pretty far ahead. They do a great job, good communication regarding what you could do to be more helpful with your pet's grooming and health. Highly recommend them.

I knew this place was gonna be good at the moment. I started talking to Emily on the phone to make my appointment. Then we got there and I saw how my dog acted around them, and was super happy. My dog always has Issues when getting groomed, so for me it’s amazing when I can tell that she feels comfortable with other humans. For however, long, I’m gonna be in Chicago. This will be the place that I will go. Thank you very much for being so awesome. I had tears , true story
Great employees, they take really good care of my little doggo 🐶 …

We’ve now been clients at all4 for about a year. We love them! They are professional, coordinated, and deeply talented. We have a 5 year old Australian Shepherd and alternate between minor “sanitary” trims and seasonal big full-body haircuts. It’s important to us to ensure we have a groomer that understands double-coated dogs, especially Aussies, and can really work with her fur and her attitude. This place is great! You get what you pay for, and here we found a place that really understands our dog, records her needs and preferences, and guides us to make good grooming choices for her. Love them!
Everyone is nice here. I’m sure your pets would love it.
Best place to come for dog grooming!

My dog rizzie gets really scared for nail trims. She doesn’t bite but has started ti snip at groomers. Instead of muzzling her, they tried a new technique: someone pets her on the head to distract her while the other cuts her nails. They are fast, caring, and a wonderful bunch. Super accommodating schedule too. I love this place.
Great friendly staff and services. Always make my pup happy and feel welcomed.
Great service!
Staff is really friendly. Gave my dog a pup cup!
I've been taking my little one here for about a year, and they've been nothing but friendly, professional, and helpful. Bonus: local business.
they charge to much
Amazing place and their customer service is outstanding!!

We only go to get my lil terriers nails trim. But always a pleasant experience.  Everyone is friendly and helpful. We don't take him to get groom as my wife likes to do herself.  But from what I have noticed, they offer all services for grooming and everyone always seems happy when picking up their pets.
Well organized,  so so kind,..    thank you.

Wonderful people that did a wonderful job on my furry elderly Husky / Shepard pup.The were so kind caring and considerate of her bad arthritis and that she get easily fatigued.I was also will be bringing my other dog  who is other dog aggressive pup to do his bath.There hours are wonderful and appointments available and accomedating.Our new Grooming place.
Best Cat Groomer around!
Everyone working here is great.  Very accomodating.

I LOVE All 4 Dirty Paws!!! I’ve been getting our three dogs groomed here for over three years now and have always been thrilled. The ladies who work reception are so friendly and helpful, they really work with me and my crazy schedule. I …
